Guard chain: installRumIngressGuards (app.ts:171 / server.ts:203, metrics-rum-ingress.ts:23-30) -> rumOriginGuard + rumLimiter (120 req/30s/IP, metrics-rum.guard.ts:135-145) + rumSamplingGuard; then metricsRumRouter (app.ts:173) rumPrivacyGuard (PII strip, guard.ts:150-191), 10kb json limit + zod (metrics-rum.ts:112-123). Stores NOTHING durable: observations go only into process-local prom-client histograms (metrics-rum.ts:156-167); RUM v2 path likewise records in-memory counters only (metrics-rum-v2.ts:156-200). No DB/queue/file -> reads-only per rubric. Review finding: Abuse-surface findings (report, not fix): (1) rumOriginGuard enforces RUM_ORIGIN_ALLOWLIST only when NODE_ENV=production AND ENABLE_RUM_V2=1 (metrics-rum.guard.ts:86-94); with v2 off and no allowlist configured, production accepts beacons from ANY origin (warn-and-continue).
